CARIAPPA:
SHRI  SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE

industrial groups owning maximum SEZs

zone-wise; and

SEZ?

Scheme

Minister of  LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether on “World Day Against
Child Labour” this year, Government
formulated “National Child Labour
Projects Scheme” (NCLPS) for welfare and
rehabilitation of children below 14 years

SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:

Investment (FDI) and corporate houses in

any protest from the small traders in this
regard and if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction in regard
thereto?

PMGSY

Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be

(a) the amount made available to Bihar

country with the Pucca road by 2010;

are proposed to be connected with the
Pucca roads;

the norms have been noticed at occasions
in the implementation of this scheme; and

metropolitan cities

Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:

planning have been taken by Central
Government to check the growing crime

(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) by when MSP for different varieties

of FDI
†*190. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to lack
of requisite infrastructure facilities in the
country, China is getting priority treatment
over India in terms of Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI);

World Investment Prospects 2007-09,

Regimental Commissioned Officers

Commissioned Officers have not been

extension in retirement age at par with
regular officers, would affect their morale
adversely, which may dampen their spirit,

undo the wrong being done in the case of
Regimental Commissioned Officers; and
(d) what is the time-frame within which
this discrepancy would be removed?
Schemes for welfare of weavers
†*192. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

executed by Government at present for the
welfare of the weavers;

Dayal Hathkargha Protsahan Yojana

Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Marine Products Export
Development Authority (MPEDA) is
giving more importance to tuna fisheries

(b) whether it is a fact that MPEDA held
some meeting in Visakhapatnam recently;
(c) if so, the details of this meeting and
achievements thereof;

marine product export and concentrate on

(e) the reasons for diversifications of

Opposition to foreign investment in
retail trade
†*194. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:

Kerala have not allowed to open Western
style retail food stores;

the protection of traditional retail business
of India;

NTC mills
†*195. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has taken a decision to close down and to
reopen some of the mills of National Textile

Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be

(a) whether it is a fact that casualty

deaths, including 988 militants while
corresponding figures for 2007 so far are
1,579 incidents and a total of 1,077 deaths,

possibly the most under-policed country

workers
*197. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering to incorporate contractual

workers; and

thereof?
Deaths due to terrorist
attacks
*198. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of people, including
Army personnel who were killed in the
country due to terrorist attacks in the last
four years;
(b) the number of arrests made in
different cases of terror attacks; and
(c) the details thereof?

*199. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) with reference to the assurance given
in reply to Unstarred Question 1507 dated
31st July, 2002 during the 196th Session,

scientists in DRDO;

(c) by when the Government is likely

the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be

Municipal Council’s (NDMC’s)
streetscaping project—claimed to be first

Teressa Crescent and Sardar Patel Marg has
been derailed on account of Delhi Metro's
high-speed link between the city centre and
the airport coming in the way;

review the streetscaping plan; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

Revamping tea industry
855. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India exported
211 million kg. of tea in 1998, but the figure
fell to 200 million kg. in 2006, and India's
tea exports declined to 75.7 million kg. in
the first half of this year despite the fact
that India has around 28 per cent of global
tea production;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a
considerable number of tea gardens have
gone sick due to lack of infrastructure,
modernization and efficient management;
and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to revamp the tea industry?

†856. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the biggest
obstruction in the progress of present
development Round of WTO in Doha is
the obstinacy of developed countries that
they are not ready to reduce the huge
subsidy which they are giving to farmers in
their countries;

developed countries to solve this problem;

employment to workers at a time when
India's target is to achieve nine per cent
growth in economy?
